headline: Phones save battery by not scanning everything
summary: Idle phones constantly measure signals from many directions, draining power. The phone checks resources such as beams one at a time and stops as soon as one meets a quality threshold, switching off its receiver. It also handles 5G signals formatted in different ways across time slots.

title: Systems and methods of secure data exchange
abstract: A method is disclosed comprising providing a federated search facility adapted to search for content on a plurality of disparate computer content storage facilities comprising receiving a computer content search request from a client computing device, wherein the user of the client computing device has access rights to secure computer content on at least one of a first content storage and a second content storage; executing a first computer content search on the first content storage and a second computer content search on the second content storage; receiving a first computer content search result from the first content storage and a second computer content search result from the second content storage; consolidating the first computer content search result and the second computer content search result into a consolidated computer content search result; and providing the consolidated computer content search result to the user as a single computer content search result.
headline: One search across many secure data stores
summary: Organisations keep documents in many separate systems, forcing users to search each one. This method runs a single search across several stores that the user is authorised to access, gathers the results from each and merges them into one combined set of results.

title: Slot machine
abstract: When an instruction game section (AT) is extended and the upper limit of an advantageous section is exceeded, it is possible to prevent the player from being given an impression that a game can be played exceeding the upper limit.   In an advantageous section, when the continuation upper limit (1500 games) of the advantageous section is reached, the advantageous section is terminated, and when the starting condition of the designated gaming section is satisfied in the advantageous section, the designated gaming section is started, When the game number addition condition is satisfied in the game section, the designated game section can be extended. If the continuation upper limit of the advantageous section is not exceeded even if the designated game section is extended, the remaining number of games after the addition is displayed. When the instruction game section is extended and the continuation upper limit of the advantageous section is exceeded, specific information (“celebration”, “congratulations”, etc.) is displayed (example 2 in the figure).   [Selection] Figure 55
headline: Clearer bonus-round limits on slot machines
summary: Gambling rules cap how long a slot machine's bonus period can run, at 1,500 games. When a player earns extra bonus games that would push past this cap, the machine shows a celebratory message instead of a game count, so players are not misled into thinking they can keep playing beyond the limit.

title: Identity management service using a block chain
abstract: Logic on a first remote device causes the capture of personal data identifying a user from an identification card. The logic generates a hash value from the personal data using a hashing algorithm and signs the hash value with a digital signature created using a private key paired with a public key. The logic transmits, over a network, the signed hash value and the public key from the remote device to a distributed public database for storage. The logic receives, over the network, a transaction number from the distributed public database. The logic then transmits the transaction number and the personal data to a second remote device. Logic on the second remote device verifies that the hash value in the signed hash value is the same as a generated hash value and verifies that the signed hash value was signed with the private key.
headline: Proving your identity using a blockchain
summary: Verifying identity documents online is slow and vulnerable to forgery. A device reads personal data from an ID card, creates a digital fingerprint of it, signs it and stores the signature on a public blockchain. A second party can then check that the data presented matches the recorded fingerprint and signature.

title: Systems and methods for scribing photovoltaic structures
abstract: A system for scribing a photovoltaic structure is provided. During operation, a conveyor can move a photovoltaic structure along a path, and a scribing apparatus is directed toward that path to scribe a groove of a predetermined depth. In one embodiment, the groove does not penetrate an interface between a base layer and an emitter layer of the photovoltaic structure.
headline: Precisely scoring solar cells for cutting
summary: Solar cells are often scored so they can be divided into strips. This system moves a solar cell along a conveyor past a scribing tool that cuts a groove to a set depth; in one version the groove stops short of the junction between the cell's two active layers.

title: Photovoltaic electrode design with contact pads for cascaded application
abstract: An electrode grid design of a photovoltaic structure is provided. The grid can include a plurality of finger lines, an edge busbar positioned near an edge of the photovoltaic structure, and a plurality of contact pads, wherein a respective contact pad is configured in such a way that, when the photovoltaic structure is cascaded with an adjacent photovoltaic structure at the edge, the contact pad is at least partially exposed.
green_codes: Y02E10/00 — Energy generation through renewable energy sources|Y02E10/50 — Photovoltaic [PV] energy
headline: Solar cell contacts designed for overlapping strips
summary: Solar cells can be overlapped like roof shingles to form a panel, but the overlap can hide the electrical contacts. This electrode layout combines thin finger lines and an edge busbar with contact pads positioned so that, when one cell is cascaded over its neighbour, the pads remain at least partly exposed for connection.

title: Compound eye optical instrument
abstract: Disclosed is a compact compound-eye optical apparatus capable of simultaneously acquiring a focused image through a plurality of imaging optical systems having different focal lengths. A compound-eye optical apparatus includes a plurality of imaging optical systems including a imaging optical system having different focal lengths. Each imaging optical system includes focus lens groups 110aF to 140bF arranged on the most object side, and fixed lens groups 110aR to 140bR that do not move during focusing. Adjacent focus lenses which are lenses constituting the focus lens group and are adjacent to each other in a direction perpendicular to the optical axis have different surface shapes. When the focal length of the tele optical system with the longest focal length is ft and the focal length of the focus lens group of the wide optical system with the shortest focal length is ffw, 0.5≰ | ffw / ft | ≰1.6 Satisfied. [Selection] Figure 2
headline: Multi-lens camera that focuses all lenses at once
summary: Cameras with several lenses of different focal lengths can capture wide and zoomed views simultaneously, but keeping every lens in focus is difficult. In this compact design each lens system has a moving focus group at the front and a fixed group behind, with neighbouring focus lenses shaped differently and focal lengths kept within a set ratio.

title: Loudspeaker module
abstract: A loudspeaker module, comprising a housing, wherein a single loudspeaker body (50) is accommodated into the housing and divides the inner cavity of the overall module into a front acoustic cavity and a rear acoustic cavity; the rear acoustic cavity is filled with sound absorbing particles (60); netlike isolating components (80a, 80b) for isolating the sound absorbing particles (60) from the single loudspeaker body (50) are also arranged in the rear acoustic cavity, and separate the overall rear acoustic cavity into a filling zone and a non-filling zone; the sound absorbing particles (60) are located in the filling zone; the sound absorbing particles (60) are made of a non-foaming material, and have the external diameters that are more than or equal to 0.01mm and are smaller than the height of the filling zone. According to the loudspeaker module, the rear cavity can be filled with the sound absorbing particles (60) to the greatest extent, and the sound absorbing performance of the filled sound absorbing particles (60) can be fully utilized, so that the loudspeaker module has the advantages of good acoustic performance, high production efficiency and low production cost.
headline: Richer sound from phone speakers using absorbent grains
summary: Compact loudspeakers sound better if the chamber behind them is acoustically larger. Here the rear cavity is filled with fine non-foaming sound-absorbing particles, held away from the speaker itself by mesh dividers, so the cavity can be filled as fully as possible and the particles' absorbing effect fully used, at low production cost.

title: Humanized steering model for automated vehicles
abstract: A humanized steering system (10) for an automated vehicle (12) includes one or more steering-wheels (16) operable to steer a vehicle (12), an angle-sensor (20) configured to determine a steering-angle (18) of the steering-wheels (16), a hand-wheel (22) used by an operator (14) of the vehicle (12) to influence the steering-angle (18) and thereby manually steer the vehicle (12), a steering-actuator (24) operable to influence the steering-angle (18) thereby steer the vehicle (12) when the operator (14) does not manually steer the vehicle (12), a position-sensor (26) operable to indicate a relative-position (28) an object (30) proximate to the vehicle (12), and a controller (32). The controller (32) is configured to receive the steering-angle (18) and the relative-position (28), determine, using deep-learning techniques, a steering-model (34) based on the steering-angle (18) and the relative-position (28), and operate the steering-actuator (24) when the operator (14) does not manually steer the vehicle (12) to steer the vehicle (12) in accordance with the steering-model (34), whereby the vehicle (12) is steered in a manner similar to how the operator (14) manually steers the vehicle (12).
headline: Self-driving cars that steer like their owner
summary: Automated steering can feel unnatural. While the driver steers manually, sensors record steering angle and the positions of nearby objects; deep learning builds a model of that driving style, which the car then applies when steering itself.

title: Systems and methods for targeted annealing of photovoltaic structures
abstract: A targeted-annealing system can automatically cure a conductive paste that may bind cascaded strips of a string. The targeted-annealing system can include a first heat-treating bar that may be heated to a first curing temperature, and can include a second heat-treating bar that may be heated to a second curing temperature. During operation, a controller of the targeted-annealing system can activate one or more actuators to conform the first heat-treating bar to a top surface of two cascaded strips, and conform the second heat-treating bar to a bottom surface of two cascaded strips. The first and second heat-treating bars may be aligned along an overlap portion between the two cascaded strips, and can heat the overlap portion to 160 degrees Celsius.
green_codes: Y02E10/00 — Energy generation through renewable energy sources|Y02E10/50 — Photovoltaic [PV] energy
headline: Heated bars cure glue joining solar strips
summary: Modern solar panels are made from overlapping strips stuck together with conductive paste that must be heated to set. Two heated bars press onto the top and bottom of each overlap and warm it to about 160 degrees Celsius, curing just the joint rather than the whole panel, for faster, more consistent manufacturing.

title: Zoom lens, and lens barrel and image pickup device provided with zoom lens
abstract: In the present invention, a zoom lens comprises the following in order from the object side: a first lens group (G1) having negative refractive power; a second lens group (G2) having positive refractive power; and a third lens group (G3) having negative refractive power. When zooming, the first lens group (G1) includes, at least, movement to the image side, the second lens group (G2) moves integrally with an aperture stop (S), and the third lens group (G3) moves to the object side. The movement of the first lens group (G1) to the image side is movement that occurs when zooming starts from the wide angle end. The movement of the third lens group (G3) to the object side is movement that occurs when zooming from the wide angle end to the telescopic end. The first lens group (G1) includes at least a negative lens and a positive lens, the negative lens being disposed on the side that is closest to the object side, and satisfies the following conditional equation: 0.75<(β 2t /β 2w )/(β 3t /β 3w )<1.38 -0.70<β 2w <-0.32 0.96<f 2 /f w <1.80
headline: Compact zoom lens design for cameras
summary: Zoom lenses must balance size against image quality. This design uses three groups of lens elements, with specific rules for how each group moves while zooming and for the ratios of their optical powers, allowing a compact lens with good performance across the zoom range, for use in cameras and interchangeable lens barrels.

title: Lens apparatus and image pickup apparatus including the same
abstract: A lens apparatus includes, in order from an object side: a first lens unit; an aperture stop; and a positive second lens unit. The first lens unit includes, in order from the object side, a first negative lens, a second negative lens having at least one aspheric surface, and a positive lens. The second lens unit includes at least one negative lens and at least two positive lenses. The first and second negative lenses of the first lens unit are meniscus lenses having a surface convex toward the object side. The focal length of the optical system, the focal lengths of the first and second lens units, the mean values of Abbe constants of the positive lens and the negative lenses of the first lens unit, and the mean values of Abbe constants of the positive lenses and the negative lenses of the second lens unit are appropriately configured.
headline: Compact high-quality camera lens design
summary: Camera lenses must balance sharpness, size and cost. This lens arrangement uses a front group of two negative meniscus lenses, one with an aspheric surface, plus a positive lens, followed by an aperture and a rear group, with glass properties chosen to control aberrations.

title: Vibrating acoustic device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical acoustic products, and specifically, to a vibrating acoustic device comprising a housing, and a vibration system and a magnetic system accommodated in the housing. One side surface of the housing is provided with a sound hole. The vibration system comprises a diaphragm, a voice coil, and a voice coil frame connecting the diaphragm and the voice coil. The voice coil is flat in structure, and is located on a plane perpendicular to a plane where the diaphragm is located. The magnetic system comprises a magnet located on a plane parallel to the plane where the voice coil is located. The vibrating acoustic device also comprises a mass piece and an elastic support piece. The elastic support piece is configured to suspend the mass piece and the magnet in the housing, and has a ring-shaped structure. The mass piece and the magnet are located at an inner side of the elastic support piece. Two opposite sides of the elastic support piece are fixedly connected to the magnet, and other two opposite sides of the elastic support piece are fixed to the housing.
headline: Speaker that also delivers vibration alerts
summary: Small devices often need both a loudspeaker and a vibration motor, which take up space. This device combines them: a flat voice coil drives a diaphragm for sound, while the magnet and an added weight are suspended on a ring-shaped spring inside the housing, allowing the unit to act as a vibrator as well.

title: Seat and seat control system
abstract: Provided is a seat in which a physical quantity can be controlled according to a physique of an occupant. One aspect of the present disclosure provides a seat including a seat body that supports a body of an occupant, at least one driving device that changes a physical quantity of the seat body, and a controller that controls the at least one driving device. The controller includes a model generator that generates a human body model of the occupant, an analyzer that analyzes a state quantity of the human body model, and an instructing device that drives the at least one driving device based on a result of an analysis by the analyzer.
headline: Car seats that adjust to the occupant's build
summary: A seat that suits one person may be uncomfortable for another of different size. The seat builds a digital model of the occupant's body, analyses how they sit, and automatically adjusts properties such as firmness or shape through built-in motors to fit them better.

title: Storage device with magnetic skyrmions and associated method
abstract: The invention relates to a storage device (10), comprising at least one spintronic element (11) suitable for representing a state among at least n states associated with the spintronic element, n>1, characterised in that each of the n states is associated with at least one characteristic of a group of magnetic skyrmions (1) in the spintronic element, and in that said characteristic associated with a state n °i is different from said characteristic associated with a state n °j when the states n °i and j are two different states among the n states.
headline: Storing data in tiny magnetic whirls
summary: Computer memory needs ever smaller and more energy-efficient ways to hold information. This device stores data using skyrmions, minute stable swirls of magnetism within a material. Different features of a group of these swirls stand for different stored values, so each element can hold more than a simple one or zero.

title: System and method for securing an enterprise computing environment
abstract: Methods and systems provided herein include a cyber intelligence system, a unified application firewall, and a cloud security fabric that has enterprise APIs for connecting to the information technology infrastructure of an enterprise, developer APIs 102 for enabling developers to access capabilities of the fabric and connector APIs by which the fabric may discover information about entities relevant to the information security of the enterprise (such as events involving users, applications, and data of the enterprise occurring on a plurality of cloud-enabled platforms, including PaaS/IaaS platforms), with various modules that comprise services deployed in the cloud security fabric, such as a selective encryption module, a policy creation and automation module, a content classification as a service module, and user and entity behavior analytics modules.
headline: Cloud security blanket for company IT systems
summary: Companies spread across many cloud services struggle to see and protect their users, apps and data. A cloud security fabric connects to the firm's infrastructure and cloud platforms, gathers security-relevant events, and offers services such as selective encryption, automated policies, content classification and user behaviour analytics.

title: Clock signal error correction in a digital-to-analog converter
abstract: In an example, there is disclosed herein a digital-to-analog converter (DAC) including a correction circuit for a clock, including a differential clock. Error correction may take place within the DAC core, by means of replica cells that are substantially similar to conversion cells. Rather than contributing their output to the converted signal, the replica cells may be configured to provide a feedback signal to a clock receiver with information for correcting the clock signal. The feedback signal may be operable to correct errors, for example, in duty cycle and crosspoint, as measured at the DAC core.
headline: Cleaner timing signals for digital-to-analogue converters
summary: Chips that turn digital data into analogue signals, as in audio and radio equipment, rely on a precise timing signal, and small flaws in it degrade output quality. Here spare copies of the converter's cells measure the timing errors from the inside and feed corrections back, so the clock is adjusted exactly where it matters.

title: Firmware component with self-descriptive dependency information
abstract: An embodiment of a semiconductor package apparatus may include technology to determine version information for a new firmware component, read dependency information corresponding to the firmware component, and determine if dependency is satisfied between the new firmware component and one or more other firmware components based on the version information and the dependency information of the new firmware component. Other embodiments are disclosed and claimed.
headline: Firmware updates that check their own compatibility
summary: Devices contain many pieces of low-level software (firmware) that must work together, and updating one can break another. Each firmware component carries a description of which versions of other components it depends on, letting the device check compatibility automatically before installing an update.

title: Image capturing lens, image capturing device, and portable terminal
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image capturing lens which has a reduced height and a small F-number and offers good imaging performance by effectively suppressing ghost and flare, and to provide an image capturing device and portable terminal having the same.SOLUTION: An image capturing lens comprises five or more lenses including a first lens L1 having positive refractive power and a second lens L2 having negative refractive power in order from the object side, and at least one of an image-side surface of the first lens L1 and an object-side and image side surfaces of the second lens L2 has a light-shielding film SM formed on an area outside an effective diameter thereof. Entry of unwanted light from an aperture end face section of the image capturing lens can thus be avoided without having to provide a shielding member somewhere close to the object side.
headline: Thin phone camera lens with less glare
summary: Slim phone cameras with wide apertures tend to suffer from ghosting and flare caused by stray light. This lens of five or more elements puts a light-blocking film on the outer rim of the first or second lens, outside the area that forms the image, stopping unwanted light without adding a separate shield.

title: Loudspeaker module
abstract: Disclosed is a loudspeaker module, which relates to the technical field of electroacoustic products. The loudspeaker module comprises a module shell, wherein a loudspeaker monomer is accommodated in the module shell; the loudspeaker monomer comprises a monomer shell and a monomer front cover engaged with each other; a vibrating system and a magnetic circuit system are accommodated in a space surrounded by the monomer shell and the monomer front cover; an end surface of a side wall of at least one side of the monomer shell is provided with an ultrasonic surface welded to the module shell by means of ultrasound; and an ultrasonic line bonded with the ultrasonic surface by means of ultrasound is provided at a position on the module shell corresponding to the ultrasonic surface. The loudspeaker module of the present invention solves the technical problems of a complex assembly process, a poor sealing performance and a poor appearance of the loudspeaker module in the prior art, and the loudspeaker module of the present invention has a simple assembly process, a good sealing performance, a high quality appearance, an excellent acoustic performance, a high production efficiency and a low production cost.
headline: Simpler, better-sealed loudspeaker assembly
summary: Small loudspeaker modules for phones are fiddly to assemble and often poorly sealed. This design gives the speaker's shell a surface that is welded to the module's outer shell using ultrasound, along a matching weld line, cutting assembly steps, improving the seal and appearance, and lowering production costs.

title: Imaging lens, imaging device, and portable terminal
headline: Camera lens for smartphones
summary: Covers an imaging lens and the camera and portable device built around it. No abstract is available, so further detail cannot be given.

title: Systems and methods for network slice management
abstract: A method of generating a network slice is provided. The method comprises a network slice orchestrator (NWSO) receiving from a network slice manager (NWSM) a request for a new network slice, the NWSO adding a new service to the new network slice, the NWSO determining a network slice descriptor (NWSD) for the new network slice, the NWSO transmitting to a resource orchestrator (RO) a request for an instantiation of the network slice using enhanced network function virtualization management and orchestration (E-MANO). A method of modifying a network slice is also provided. The method comprises a NWSO receiving from a NWSM a request to add a new service to a network slice, the NWSO adding a new service to the network slice, the NWSO determining a NWSD for the network slice with the added service, and the NWSO transmitting to a RO a request for an instantiation of the added service on the network slice using E-MANO. A method of terminating a network slice is also provided. The method comprises a NWSO receiving from a NWSM a request to terminate a network slice, the NWSO determining the subnetworks to terminate, and the NWSO transmitting to a RO a request for a termination of the slice specific network functions (NFs).
headline: Creating custom virtual networks on demand
summary: 5G networks are divided into slices tailored to different services. An orchestrator receives requests to create, modify or terminate a slice, adds services, prepares a descriptor and instructs a resource orchestrator to set up or tear down the required virtual network functions.

title: Speaker module
abstract: Disclosed is a speaker module, comprising an active sound source, a passive sound source and a protective frame; the active sound source comprises a vibration system and a magnetic circuit system; the side surface of the protective frame is provided with a sound hole for the active sound source; the passive sound source comprises two passive radiators, and the two passive radiators are arranged in parallel and enclose a cavity; a sound wave at one side of a vibrating diaphragm adjacent to the magnetic circuit system is divided into two parts respectively transmitted to one side of each of the two passive radiators away from the cavity; and a sound wave in the cavity is projected and emitted to the external environment via a sound hole for the passive sound source. The structure improves the bass effect of the speaker module, and improves the acoustic performance of the product.
headline: Deeper bass from compact speaker modules
summary: Small speakers in phones and portable devices struggle to produce bass. This module adds two passive radiators arranged in parallel to enclose a cavity. Sound from the back of the main speaker's diaphragm is split between them, and the sound inside the cavity is channelled out through a separate opening, improving the bass response.

title: Sound production apparatus and electronic device
abstract: The present invention relates to a sound production apparatus and an electronic device. The sound production apparatus comprises a magnetic circuit system, and a first vibration system and a second vibration system located on both surfaces of the magnetic circuit system. The magnetic circuit system comprises a central magnet located in the middle. A first magnetic gap for allowing a first voice coil of the first vibration system to extend is formed on one surface of the magnetic circuit system. A second magnetic gap for allowing a second voice coil of the second vibration system to extend is formed on the other surface of the magnetic circuit system. The first magnetic gap and the second magnetic gap are located at an outer side of the central magnet. The first magnetic gap is distant from the central magnet. At least the first vibration system further comprises a first diaphragm and a connection piece having a folding ring. The first diaphragm is located on one end of the first voice coil distant from the magnetic circuit system. The connection piece is connected onto a bottom end of the first voice coil facing towards the magnetic circuit system to limit the first voice coil to vertically vibrate in the direction perpendicular to the first magnetic gap.
headline: Compact loudspeaker with two diaphragms
summary: A small speaker for phones and other devices places vibrating diaphragms on both sides of a single magnet assembly, each driven by its own coil. A connecting piece keeps the coil moving straight, allowing more sound from a compact unit.

title: System and method for securing an enterprise computing environment
abstract: Methods and systems provided herein include a cyber intelligence system, a unified application firewall, and a cloud security fabric that has enterprise APIs for connecting to the information technology infrastructure of an enterprise, developer APIs 102 for enabling developers to access capabilities of the fabric and connector APIs by which the fabric may discover information about entities relevant to the information security of the enterprise (such as events involving users, applications, and data of the enterprise occurring on a plurality of cloud-enabled platforms, including PaaS/IaaS platforms), with various modules that comprise services deployed in the cloud security fabric, such as a selective encryption module, a policy creation and automation module, a content classification as a service module, and user and entity behavior analytics modules.
headline: Cloud security blanket for company IT systems
summary: Companies spread across many cloud services struggle to see and protect their users, apps and data. A cloud security fabric connects to the firm's infrastructure and cloud platforms, gathers security-relevant events, and offers services such as selective encryption, automated policies, content classification and user behaviour analytics.

title: Network architecture, methods, and devices for a wireless communications network
abstract: Methods performed by a wireless device, such as a user equipment, operating in a dormant mode comprise performing a measurement on each of a plurality of resources from a predetermined set of resources or demodulating and decoding information from each of a plurality of resources from a predetermined set of resources, such as a set of beams. The methods further include evaluating the measurement or the demodulated and decoded information for each of the plurality of resources against a predetermined criterion, and then discontinuing the performing and evaluating of measurements, or discontinuing the demodulating and decoding and evaluation of information, in response to determining that the predetermined criterion is met, such that one or more resources in the predetermined set of resources are neither measured nor demodulated and decoded. The methods further comprise deactivating receiver circuitry, further in response to determining that the predetermined criterion is met. The method further comprises receiving, in a first downlink subframe, a first Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing transmission formatted according to a first numerology and receiving, in a second downlink subframe, a second OFDM transmission formatted according to a second numerology, the second numerology differing from the first numerology.

headline: Phones save battery by not scanning everything
summary: Idle phones constantly measure signals from many directions, draining power. The phone checks resources such as beams one at a time and stops as soon as one meets a quality threshold, switching off its receiver. It also handles 5G signals formatted in different ways across time slots.

title: Methods and devices for radio communications
abstract: A communication device can include a processor configured to receive, on a radio channel, an uplink radio transmission in a first waveform format from a terminal device that instructs the communication device to forward the uplink radio transmission to a network access node, and transmit, on the radio channel, the uplink radio transmission to the network access node with a preamble in a second waveform format to protect the uplink radio transmission from collisions.
green_codes: Y02D30/00 — Reducing energy consumption in communication networks|Y02D30/70 — Reducing energy consumption in communication networks in wireless communication networks
headline: Relaying phone signals to avoid radio collisions
summary: A device such as a phone may be too far from a base station to reach it directly, so another device relays its transmission. The relay adds a preamble in a different signal format before forwarding, which warns other users of the channel and protects the relayed data from collisions.

title: Speaker vibration system
abstract: A speaker vibration system comprises a diaphragm body part (1) and a voice coil (2) combined at a lower side of the diaphragm body part (1). The diaphragm body part (1) comprises a rigid dome part (11), a silicone rubber membrane (12) and a plastic stent (13) combined at an edge of the silicone rubber membrane (12). The dome part (11) is combined at a middle position of the silicone rubber membrane (12). A convex or concave suspension ring part (120) is arranged at a position that is located at an outer side of the dome part (11) on the silicone rubber membrane (12). A space between an outer side edge of the dome part (11) and an inner side edge of the suspension ring part is in a value range from 0.02mm to 0.2mm. In addition, colloid (14) is coated in a gap between the dome part (11) and the suspension ring part (120). The speaker vibration system can improve sensibility of a product, reduce distortion and improve acoustic performance of the product.
headline: Clearer sound from small loudspeakers
summary: Tiny speakers in phones and headphones often distort sound. This design uses a rigid dome mounted on a silicone rubber membrane with a plastic frame, a ring-shaped suspension around the dome, and a very small adhesive-filled gap between the two, aimed at greater sensitivity, less distortion and better sound quality.

title: Voltage translator
abstract: A voltage translator translates an input voltage signal in a low voltage domain into a output voltage signal in a high voltage domain using a latch that includes a pair of cross-coupled inverters. The bottom rail voltages for the cross-coupled inverters are varied dynamically to speed switching time for the voltage translator.
headline: Faster signal bridge between chip voltage levels
summary: Different parts of a chip often run at different voltages, and signals must be converted when crossing between them. This circuit speeds up that conversion by dynamically adjusting the voltage references inside a small memory element, so data moves between low- and high-voltage sections with less delay.

title: Disc brake
abstract: The disc brake is started. According to an aspect of the present invention, there is provided a friction pad comprising: a pair of pad plates having friction pads attached to both sides of a disk rotating together with a wheel and having protrusions formed on both sides thereof; And a pad spring interposed between the carrier and the pair of pad plates for supporting the pair of pad plates in a slidable manner, Wherein the pad spring has an upper contact portion which is in close contact with an upper surface of the carrier, a coupling portion which is connected to the upper contact portion and is coupled to the coupling jaw, And a guide portion coupled to the guide portion, And a resilient supporting portion that extends from the upper close contact portion to extend in a direction away from the pair of pad plates.
headline: Spring keeps brake pads steady and quiet
summary: Brake pads in disc brakes can rattle and wear unevenly. A specially shaped spring sits between the brake carrier and pad plates, gripping the carrier and supporting the pads so they slide smoothly while being held firmly.

title: Brake device of transmission
abstract: In a brake device of a transmission, rotation side friction plates are engaged with a cylindrical part of a rotation side holding member, and fixed side friction plates are engaged with a spline part that is provided on an outer peripheral surface of an inner cylindrical part of a fixed side holding member opposed to a cylindrical part of the rotation side holding member. The fixed side holding member includes an inflow oil passage that supplies lubricating oil from the outside to the inside of the radial direction thereof. An annular space communicating with an inflow oil passage is provided on the inside of the cylindrical part of the fixed side holding member. Oil discharge holes supplying lubricating oil, which was flowed into the annular space, to the rotation side and fixed side friction plates are provided on the cylindrical part of the fixed side holding member.
headline: Better lubrication for automatic gearbox brakes
summary: Automatic transmissions use friction brakes made of stacked plates that must be kept oiled to avoid wear and overheating. Oil flows through a passage in the fixed holder into a ring-shaped chamber and out through holes directly onto the rotating and fixed plates, improving lubrication.

title: Network architecture, methods, and devices for a wireless communications network
abstract: Methods and apparatus in a fifth-generation wireless communications, including an example method, in a wireless device, that includes receiving a downlink signal comprising an uplink access configuration index, using the uplink access configuration index to identify an uplink access configuration from among a predetermined plurality of uplink access configurations, and transmitting to the wireless communications network according to the identified uplink access configuration. The example method further includes, in the same wireless device, receiving, in a first downlink subframe, a first Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing, OFDM, transmission formatted according to a first numerology and receiving, in a second downlink subframe, a second OFDM transmission formatted according to a second numerology, the second numerology differing from the first numerology, where the first numerology has a first subcarrier spacing and the second numerology has a second subcarrier spacing, the first subcarrier spacing differing from the second subcarrier spacing. The example method further includes, in the same wireless device, receiving and processing first Layer 2 data on a first physical data channel and receiving and processing second Layer 2 data on a second physical data channel, wherein the receiving and processing of the first Layer 2 data comprises the use of soft HARQ combining and wherein the receiving and processing of the second Layer 2 data comprises no soft HARQ combining. Variants of this method, corresponding apparatuses, and corresponding network-side methods and apparatuses are also disclosed.
headline: Building blocks for faster 5G mobile networks
summary: Mobile networks must serve very different needs at once, from streaming video to tiny sensor messages. Phones and base stations can be told how to transmit using short codes, mix different radio signal formats in consecutive time slots and handle some data streams with error-correction and others without. This flexibility underpins fifth-generation (5G) networks.

title: Advanced analytical infrastructure for machine learning
abstract: Machine learning systems (10) and computerized methods (100) to compare candidate machine learning algorithms are disclosed. The machine learning system (10) comprises a machine learning algorithm library (22), a data input module (20) to receive a dataset and a selection of machine learning models (32) derived from the machine learning algorithm library (22), an experiment module (30), and an aggregation module (40). The experiment module (30) is configured to train and evaluate (106) each machine learning model (32) to produce a performance result for each machine learning model (32). The aggregation module (40) is configured to aggregate the performance results for all of the machine learning models (32) to form performance comparison statistics. Computerized methods (100) include receiving (102) a dataset, receiving (104) a selection of machine learning models (32), training and evaluating (106) each machine learning model (32) to produce a performance result for each machine learning model (32), aggregating (108) the performance results to form performance comparison statistics, and presenting (110) the performance comparison statistics.
headline: Test bench for comparing machine-learning methods
summary: Choosing the best machine-learning approach for a dataset usually means laborious trial and error. This system holds a library of algorithms, trains and evaluates each selected model on a dataset, and aggregates the results into comparison statistics presented to the user.

title: Content adaptive super resolution prediction generation for next generation video coding
abstract: Techniques related to super resolution prediction generation for video coding are described.
headline: Sharper video prediction for next-generation compression
summary: Video compression works by predicting each frame from earlier ones. This covers techniques for generating higher-resolution predictions, adapted to the content, to improve coding efficiency in next-generation video formats.

title: Wireless communication technology, apparatuses, and methods
abstract: Millimeter wave (mmWave) technology, apparatuses, and methods that relate to transceivers, receivers, and antenna structures for wireless communications are described. The various aspects include co-located millimeter wave (mmWave) and near-field communication (NFC) antennas, scalable phased array radio transceiver architecture (SPARTA), phased array distributed communication system with MIMO support and phase noise synchronization over a single coax cable, communicating RF signals over cable (RFoC) in a distributed phased array communication system, clock noise leakage reduction, IF-to-RF companion chip for backwards and forwards compatibility and modularity, on-package matching networks, 5G scalable receiver (Rx) architecture, among others.
headline: Antenna and radio designs for 5G devices
summary: Very high-frequency 'millimetre wave' radio promises fast 5G connections but is hard to build into compact devices. A collection of designs covers combined antennas, scalable phased-array transceivers, sending radio signals over a single cable, reducing clock noise and modular chip arrangements for receivers.

title: Assembled battery and assembled battery production method
abstract: Provided is an assembled battery that has improved reliability as a result of the adhesion/fixation of a battery cell to a holding body and a case being simplified and strengthened and of electrode terminals being accurately positioned. The present invention is characterized by comprising: a battery cell (150) that has a cap surface (151) and a can bottom surface (155) that faces the cap surface (151); a holding body (120) that holds the battery cell (150); a case (110) that engages the holding body (120) and that houses the holding body (120) and the battery cell (150); a first adhesion part (170) that adheres the battery cell (150) and the holding body (120); and a second adhesion part (180) that adheres the battery cell (150) and the case (110). The present invention is also characterized in that the first adhesion part (170) is provided between an end part of the cap surface (151) and a corresponding portion of the holding body (120) and in that the second adhesion part (180) is provided between an approximately central part of the can bottom surface (155) and a corresponding portion of the case (110).

headline: Sturdier battery packs with glued-in cells
summary: Battery packs for cars and other machines bundle many cells inside a case, and loose or misaligned cells cause faults. Each cell is glued at the top to a holder and at the bottom to the case, which fixes it firmly and lines up its terminals accurately, making the pack more reliable and simpler to assemble.

title: Modular i/o configurations for edge computing using disaggregated chiplets
abstract: Various approaches for deployment and use of configurable edge computing platforms are described. In an edge computing system, an edge computing device includes hardware resources that can be composed from a configuration of chiplets, as the chiplets are disaggregated for selective use and deployment (for compute, acceleration, memory, storage, or other resources). In an example, configuration operations are performed to: identify a condition for use of the hardware resource, based on an edge computing workload received at the edge computing device; obtain, determine, or identify properties of a configuration for the hardware resource that are available to be implemented with the chiplets, with the configuration enabling the hardware resource to satisfy the condition for use of the hardware resource; and compose the chiplets into the configuration, according to the properties of the configuration, to enable the use of the hardware resource for the edge computing workload.

headline: Mix-and-match chips for edge computing
summary: Edge computing devices near users must handle widely varying workloads. By building hardware from small separable chip components (chiplets) for processing, memory, storage and acceleration, the device can assemble the configuration each incoming workload needs.

title: Resource allocation for d2d discovery in an lte network
abstract: Embodiments of user equipment (UE), an enhanced node B (eNB), and methods of signaling for proximity services and device-to-device (D2D) discovery in an LTE network are generally described herein. In some embodiments, the UE receives configuration information for a D2D discovery resource pool of a cell. The configuration information includes an indication that the D2D discovery resource pool has been logically divided into a plurality of sub-discovery resource pools. The UE performs an initial transmission of a discovery signal in a discovery period using a single D2D discovery resource from a first sub-discovery resource pool of the plurality of sub-discovery resource pools. The UE performs a number of additional transmissions of the discovery signal in the discovery period using additional D2D discovery resources from sub-discovery resource pools of the plurality of sub-discovery resource pools other than the first sub-discovery resource pool. Other apparatuses and methods are also described.

headline: Letting phones find each other directly on 4G
summary: Phones nearby could communicate directly without routing through the network, but they first need to discover one another. This scheme divides the radio resources set aside for discovery into sub-pools and has a phone send its discovery signal repeatedly using resources from different sub-pools, improving the chance of being found.

title: Super resolution using a generative adversarial network
abstract: A neural network is trained to process received visual data to estimate a high-resolution version of the visual data using a training dataset and reference dataset. A set of training data is generated and a generator convolutional neural network parameterized by first weights and biases is trained by comparing characteristics of the training data to characteristics of the reference dataset. The first network is trained to generate super-resolved image data from low-resolution image data and the training includes modifying first weights and biases to optimize processed visual data based on the comparison between the characteristics of the training data and the characteristics of the reference dataset. A discriminator convolutional neural network parameterized by second weights and biases is trained by comparing characteristics of the generated super-resolved image data to characteristics of the reference dataset, and where the second network is trained to discriminate super-resolved image data from real image data.
headline: Using duelling neural networks to sharpen images
summary: Enlarging a small picture usually produces a blurry result. Here two artificial neural networks are trained against each other: one invents sharp high-resolution versions of low-resolution images, while the other tries to tell these fakes from real photographs. The competition pushes the first network to produce convincingly detailed images.

title: Coil of stator core for method of vehicle motor
abstract: The present invention relates to a stator manufacturing method using a coil that simplifies a process and can reduce manufacturing costs, and a motor for a motor using the stator. The stator core has a plurality of slots that are opened toward the inner circumferential surface and are spaced apart from each other in the circumferential direction step; Preparing a plurality of wire rods formed by straightening a coil to be coupled to the stator core and cutting the wire into a length longer than a height of the stator core; Inserting an insulating paper having a shape corresponding to the shape of the slot into the slot so as to mutually insulate the wire rod and the stator core; Disposing the wire rod in the slot so that an intermediate portion of the wire rod is placed in an inner space of the slot surrounded by the insulating paper; And the upper and lower portions exposed from the stator core extend obliquely along the circumferential direction so that the upper end and the lower end of the stator core extend in opposite directions along the height direction of the stator core, And repeating the arranging step and the twisting step so that an end of the one side wire overlaps with an end of the other side wire along the radial direction of the stator core and the height of the overlapped ends is smaller than the height of the stator core, And is disposed close to the surface of the core.
headline: Cheaper way to wind electric motor coils
summary: Winding stator coils for vehicle motors is complex and costly. Straightened wire pieces are cut, slipped into insulated slots in the stator core and their exposed ends twisted in opposite directions and overlapped, simplifying manufacture and reducing cost.

title: Systems and Methods for Decentralizing Commerce and Rights Management for Digital Assets Using a Blockchain Rights Ledger
abstract: Systems and methods for decentralizing commerce and rights management for digital assets using a blockchain rights ledger in accordance with embodiments of the invention are disclosed. In one embodiment, a playback device for accessing content using a decentralized blockchain rights ledger includes a processor, a network interface, a memory connected to the processor, where the memory includes: a decentralized blockchain rights ledger, a platform identifier, a public and private key pair associated with the platform, a ledger modification application, and a playback application, the ledger modification application configures the processor to: receive a first new block created and distributed by a first blockchain management device, update the decentralized blockchain rights ledger with the first new block received from the first blockchain management device, the playback application directs the processor to: obtain an encrypted digital media work, generate a digital representation of the digital media work stored in memory, locate a platform license transaction corresponding to the identified digital representation and matching platform identification number, where the platform activation transaction identifies a platform that is permitted to play back the digital media work and contains an encrypted content key with which the digital media work can be decrypted, where the encrypted content key is encrypted with a public key of a public and private key pair associated with the identified platform, and decrypt the encrypted content key using the private key of the public and private key pair associated with the platform, and decrypt content from the digital media work using the decrypted content key and play back the decrypted content.
headline: Blockchain record of who may play digital media
summary: Managing rights to films, music and other digital content usually depends on a central authority. This system records licences on a shared blockchain ledger; a playback device finds the licence matching its own identity, decrypts the content key with its private key and plays the content.

abstract: Eco-friendly systems, methods and processes/processing (EFSMP) or an integrated Matrix encompasses stand-alone and/or interconnected modules for completely self-sustained, closed-loop, emission-free processing of mutiple source feedstock that can include pretreatment, with poisoning materials isolated during pretreatment being further recycled to provide useful materials such as, for example, separated metals, carbon and fullerenes for production of nano materials, sulfur, water, sulfuric acid, gas, heat and carbon dioxide for energy production, and production of refined petroleum, at a highly-reduced cost over the best state-of-the-art refining methods/systems that meets new emissions standards as well as optimizes production output with new ultra-speed cycle times. headline: Closed-loop recycling of waste into fuels and materials
summary: Refining and waste processing usually produce emissions and discarded by-products. This proposes an integrated set of modules that processes varied feedstocks in a sealed, emission-free loop, pre-treating them to separate harmful substances and recover metals, carbon, sulphur, water and gases for energy, while producing refined petroleum products at lower cost.

title: Methods and apparatus for device-to-device communications system
abstract: A method includes configuring one or multiple pools of Device-to-Device (D2D) communication resources by an eNodeB (eNB). The method also includes signaling of the configured pool(s) of D2D communication resources by the eNB to a first User Equipment (UE) and a plurality of UEs using a common broadcast channel; and sending a request for one or multiple D2D communication resources to an eNB by the first UE configured to transmit D2D messages. The method also includes determining one or multiple resources for D2D communication by an eNB for the first UE. The method also includes communicating D2D resource allocation information to the first UE.
headline: Letting phones talk directly to each other
summary: Nearby mobile devices can communicate directly rather than routing everything through the network, but they need to know which radio resources to use. Here the base station sets aside pools of resources, announces them over a broadcast channel, and allocates specific slots to a device that asks to send direct messages.

title: Information processing system, information processing device, information processing program, and information processing method
abstract: The purpose of the invention is to simplify user operations. An information processing system executes an application such as a game application or the like. The information processing system acquires user information for calculating information pertaining to user sleep and determines a state pertaining to user sleep on the basis of the acquired user information. The information processing system determines, for example, when the user has woken up and when the user has left bed. The information processing system executes a prescribed information process in the application in coordination with a state pertaining to user sleep.
headline: Games that react to when you sleep
summary: Sleep-tracking apps usually make users enter data or start things manually. This system gathers sleep information automatically, works out when a person has woken or got out of bed, and lets a game or other app respond to those moments without extra effort from the user.

title: Network architecture, methods, and devices for a wireless communications network
abstract: Methods performed by a wireless device, such as a user equipment, operating in a dormant mode comprise performing a measurement on each of a plurality of resources from a predetermined set of resources or demodulating and decoding information from each of a plurality of resources from a predetermined set of resources, such as a set of beams. The methods further include evaluating the measurement or the demodulated and decoded information for each of the plurality of resources against a predetermined criterion, and then discontinuing the performing and evaluating of measurements, or discontinuing the demodulating and decoding and evaluation of information, in response to determining that the predetermined criterion is met, such that one or more resources in the predetermined set of resources are neither measured nor demodulated and decoded. The methods further comprise deactivating receiver circuitry, further in response to determining that the predetermined criterion is met. The method further comprises receiving, in a first downlink subframe, a first Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing transmission formatted according to a first numerology and receiving, in a second downlink subframe, a second OFDM transmission formatted according to a second numerology, the second numerology differing from the first numerology.

headline: Phones save battery by not scanning everything
summary: Idle phones constantly measure signals from many directions, draining power. The phone checks resources such as beams one at a time and stops as soon as one meets a quality threshold, switching off its receiver. It also handles 5G signals formatted in different ways across time slots.

title: System and method for securing an enterprise computing environment
abstract: Methods and systems provided herein include a cyber intelligence system, a unified application firewall, and a cloud security fabric that has enterprise APIs for connecting to the information technology infrastructure of an enterprise, developer APIs 102 for enabling developers to access capabilities of the fabric and connector APIs by which the fabric may discover information about entities relevant to the information security of the enterprise (such as events involving users, applications, and data of the enterprise occurring on a plurality of cloud-enabled platforms, including PaaS/IaaS platforms), with various modules that comprise services deployed in the cloud security fabric, such as a selective encryption module, a policy creation and automation module, a content classification as a service module, and user and entity behavior analytics modules.
headline: Cloud security blanket for company IT systems
summary: Companies spread across many cloud services struggle to see and protect their users, apps and data. A cloud security fabric connects to the firm's infrastructure and cloud platforms, gathers security-relevant events, and offers services such as selective encryption, automated policies, content classification and user behaviour analytics.

abstract: A communication device can include a processor configured to receive, on a radio channel, an uplink radio transmission in a first waveform format from a terminal device that instructs the communication device to forward the uplink radio transmission to a network access node, and transmit, on the radio channel, the uplink radio transmission to the network access node with a preamble in a second waveform format to protect the uplink radio transmission from collisions.

headline: Relaying phone signals to avoid radio collisions
summary: A device such as a phone may be too far from a base station to reach it directly, so another device relays its transmission. The relay adds a preamble in a different signal format before forwarding, which warns other users of the channel and protects the relayed data from collisions.

title: Convolutional, long short-term memory, fully connected deep neural networks
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for identifying the language of a spoken utterance. One of the methods includes receiving input features of an utterance; and processing the input features using an acoustic model that comprises one or more convolutional neural network (CNN) layers, one or more long short-term memory network (LSTM) layers, and one or more fully connected neural network layers to generate a transcription for the utterance.
headline: Combined neural network for speech recognition
summary: Transcribing speech accurately is difficult. This approach feeds audio features through a model that stacks three kinds of neural network layers, convolutional, long short-term memory and fully connected, to produce a transcription, and can also identify the language being spoken.

title: Power conversion device for connection to grid
abstract: Provided is a power converter not using a PLL circuit for use in detecting a system frequency and capable of continuous operation regardless of a variation in system voltage or frequency. The power converter includes: a power conversion unit (3) configured to convert DC power inputted thereto into AC power; and a control unit (12) configured to control the power conversion unit 3 such that the power conversion unit (3) operates as a virtual synchronous generator. The control unit (12) includes: an AVR model unit (70) configured to perform arithmetic operation to obtain an induced voltage of the virtual synchronous generator; a governor and driving source model unit (80) configured to perform arithmetic operation to obtain a driving torque driving the virtual synchronous generator; a power generation torque arithmetic operation unit (40) configured to perform arithmetic operation to obtain a power generation torque of the virtual synchronous generator; a rotation angle arithmetic operation unit (50) configured to perform arithmetic operation based on at least an acceleration torque and inertia of a rotor of the virtual synchronous generator to obtain a rotation angle of the rotor; a voltage d-q conversion unit (60) configured to perform arithmetic operation with use of the rotation angle of the rotor to obtain a d-axis component and a q-axis component of an output voltage; and a generator model unit (30) configured to perform arithmetic operation, with use of an algebraic expression that is specified by a phasor diagram representing a relationship among an induced voltage, a phase voltage, and a line current of a synchronous generator, to obtain a d-axis current command value and the q-axis current command value corresponding to a d-axis component and a q-axis component of an armature current of the virtual synchronous generator.

headline: Inverter that behaves like a conventional generator
summary: Solar panels, batteries and similar sources feed the grid through power converters, which usually need to lock on to the grid frequency and can trip during disturbances. This converter instead mimics the physics of a traditional spinning generator, including its inertia and voltage control, so it keeps running despite swings in grid voltage or frequency.

title: Washing method and device and washing method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a washing method and device and a washing method and device. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that the clothes in a washing machine barrel are photographed through a camera arranged on the washing machine to obtain images; analyzing the image to obtain attribute information of the clothes, wherein the attribute information comprises at least one of the following items: the material of the garment, the size of the garment; acquiring water quality information of water for washing clothes in a washing machine barrel; and adjusting the washing mode according to the water quality information and the attribute information. The invention solves the technical problem that the washing mode of the washing machine cannot be flexibly adjusted in the related art, so that the user experience is reduced.
headline: Washing machine that looks at your laundry
summary: Choosing the right wash cycle is guesswork for many users. A camera inside the washing machine photographs the load, software works out the fabric type and quantity, and together with a reading of the water quality the machine adjusts the washing programme automatically.
